sources.title: American Express 2025 Annual Report
sources.scope: Global business model; report year 2025, printed pp. 2–4
sources.evidence: Issuing, acquiring and network businesses include direct and contractual partner relationships.
sources.limitations: Business topology only; no internal software schema. SEC HTML exceeded tool size; issuer-hosted PDF read instead.

sources.title: Terms and Conditions for Account Managers
sources.evidence: Access varies by product and channel; Limited Access permits payment scheduling.
sources.limitations: Dated permissions; do not equate names with Etail roles. Same source as I02.

sources.title: US Corporate Company Profile User Guide
sources.evidence: Hierarchy/exposure views, separate banking officer and payer, reviewed payments and tracking.
sources.limitations: Does not define Etail delegation defaults, numbers of permitted banks or payment timing.

sources.title: @ Work Reconciliation Program Administrator Reference Guide
sources.evidence: Role/resource assignments, validated accounting data and import-task results.
sources.limitations: Historic reference; p.21 rendered and visually inspected. Private tool not used; no reuse of deletion periods or import defaults.

sources.title: @ Work Reporting Global Guide
sources.evidence: Program reporting covers activity, limits, delinquencies, allocations and exposure.
sources.limitations: Product and country availability varies; line-item data can be absent. p.13 visually inspected; not a complete live report audit.

sources.title: American Express Certification
sources.evidence: Host certification and product/POS certification have distinct requirements.
sources.limitations: Detailed specifications are access-controlled; no certification or protocol compatibility established.

sources.title: American Express SafeKey
sources.evidence: EMV 3DS authentication supports challenges and frictionless flows; merchant enablement is through provider.
sources.limitations: No liability conclusion, protocol implementation or provider entitlement inferred.

sources.title: American Express Tokenization Services
sources.scope: Global network; availability by country/use case; undated
sources.evidence: Stored-card, wallet and checkout token use cases have domain controls and enrollment.
sources.limitations: Etail payment-link QR is not evidence of network-token QR support; no credentials handled.

sources.title: What are passkeys and how do they work?
sources.evidence: Passkeys can be managed; password access remains.
sources.limitations: Current Etail Identity passkey compatibility is unverified; no alternate authentication engine authorized.

sources.title: US Security Center
sources.evidence: Saved devices, two-step verification and fraud notifications are customer controls.
sources.limitations: Same source as I16; provider/session implementations and full UI not inspected.

sources.title: Amex Sync Commercial Partner Program
sources.scope: US operations currently required for partners; eligible US Business/Corporate card accounts; undated
sources.evidence: Selected partners embed virtual cards and integrated transaction data after approval.
sources.limitations: No application made. Does not establish consumer/Household origination or acquiring; developer endpoint retrieval failed.

sources.title: Corporate Account Reconciliation Fact Sheet
sources.evidence: Accounting allocation, exception review, approvals, receipts and ERP extracts.
sources.limitations: Features vary with enrollment/product; Etail journals remain immutable regardless of editable accounting metadata.

sources.title: American Express Japan Merchant Home
sources.evidence: Merchant information includes transactions, transfers, billing and profile procedures.
sources.limitations: Used for regional boundary check, not proof of full Japanese workflow parity.
